name: Sable Fix Core 1.3.0
body:
## v1.3.0 — Repair in GUI

- 🖥️ **Repair from the panel**: Save Check tab now has a Fix button per problem file — first click shows a dry-run plan (slots to clear), second click confirms and applies with automatic backup
- 🔄 result banner + auto re-scan after repair; chat shows the backup path
- 🔒 same permission gate as /sablefix (level 2); file-locked state gives a stop-server hint

## 中文
- 🖥️ **面板内修复**：「存档体检」页每个问题文件一键修复 — 首点 dry 预览死槽，再点确认执行（自动备份）
- 🔄 修复后横幅提示 + 列表自动重扫，聊天栏显示备份路径
